spine.claim: Retail instincts lure investors into cheap falling stocks, while institutional winners look expensive and make new highs.
The CAN SLIM framework decodes institutional accumulation through explosive earnings and supply-demand footprints.
Proper base patterns like the cup-with-handle shake out weak hands before institutional breakouts begin.
General market direction rules and rigid 7-8% loss cutoffs protect capital from fatal drawdown.
Stock market mastery requires abandoning personal opinion and executing the mathematical tape with strict discipline.
